name: store-finder
description: Manage store locations, search by distance and show Google maps.
author: Sebastian Fischer

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.build:css: npm run lint:css && npm run prefix:css && npm run minify:css
scripts.update:backend:leaflet: mkdir -p ../Resources/Public/JavaScript/leaflet && cp node_modules/leaflet/dist/leaflet-src.esm.js* ../Resources/Public/JavaScript/leaflet/ && cp node_modules/leaflet/dist/leaflet.css ../Resources/Public/JavaScript/leaflet/ && cp -r node_modules/leaflet/dist/images ../Resources/Public/JavaScript/leaflet/
scripts.rollup:ts: npm run rollup:ts:backend && npm run rollup:ts:googlemap && npm run rollup:ts:openstreetmap
scripts.minify:ts: npm run minify:ts:backend && npm run minify:ts:googlemap && npm run minify:ts:openstreetmap
scripts.build:js: npm run lint:ts && npm run compile:ts && npm run rollup:ts && npm run minify:ts && npm run update:backend:leaflet
